market_observations.key_finding: The majority of junior legal roles at local UAE law firms mandate Arabic. English-only or Arabic-preferred roles are concentrated at: (1) global IP services firms like Abion, (2) international tech/digital companies hiring through recruitment consultancies, (3) international law firm back-offices. Abion is the standout match this run.
market_observations.recommended_next_run: Run Type B (Week 2): Search Indeed UAE + GulfTalent + company career pages: DLA Piper UAE, CMS UAE, Dentons, King & Spalding — these international firms were not fully canvassed this run
